thread:
Jordan: heads-up — enterprise customer sent a request to onboard a new open model: solstice-14b. They need hosted + private options, and want a cost/latency estimate for FP16 vs int8 quant. Can we triage priority?
Sara: noted. who owns initial quant experiments? have we validated model weights format (hf + sharded) yet?
Jordan: cc @Mike for packaging. Customer attached HF repo link and eval rubric (short Q&A + summarization). weights are sharded in 8 files.
Mike: I can take the packaging. quick checklist: 1) confirm tokenizer + vocab match 2) convert to our Llama-compat loader 3) smoke run FP16 on a small node. ETA today afternoon.
Olivia: for private deployments — need to precheck memory footprint for int8 EVA path. Can someone run peak mem profile?
Kevin: I can run a continuous-batch profile. Do we have a sample prompt set from the customer? else use generic summarization benchmark.
Jordan: customer provided prompt_set_v1.json in the ticket. It has ~200 prompts; ~60% summarization, 30% Q&A, 10% code.
Sara: for quant plan: propose two experiments in parallel — GPTQ int8 (per-channel) and PTQ-aware tuning (8-bit only on attn/kvcache). Measure: throughput @2048 context, median latency @1-4 requests, and eval metrics (rouge, acc) on their prompts.
Mike: packing notes:
```
# quick packaging steps
python convert.py --src hf_repo/ --out /models/solstice-14b/ --dtype float16 --sharded
# run local smoke
python serve_smoke.py --model /models/solstice-14b/ --max-seq 2048
```
Kevin: running the memory profile now. will push logs to /tmp/solstice-profile-176543. ETA 30m.
eval-bot: auto-check: tokenizer mismatch test passed. detected tokenizer: llama-tokenizer v1.3. No OOVs in prompt_set_v1.json.
Jordan: excellent. next: set priority — customer requested GA in 6 weeks but willing to accept hosted-only first. recommend: priority = high, onboard hosted FP16 asap, run quant experiments mid-week, then private packaging after quant sign-off.
Sara: action items: @Mike start packaging + smoke FP16; @Kevin run int8 GPTQ on one shard as spike; @Olivia prep private-deploy checklist and infra size estimate. I'll own eval dashboards and metric diff thresholds.
Mike: ack. I'll post a short PR with model card + runbook into models repo when FP16 smoke passes.
Kevin: spike note: will try GPTQ with 128-bit block first. if it fails, fallback to per-channel sym quant.
Olivia: for private checklist — need KMS integration note + HSM stub, and confirm that audit logs will be forwarded to their SIEM. drafting now.
Jordan: thanks all. let's reconvene here when initial smoke logs are up. If anyone hits a quality regression >3% rouge drop, flag and pause quant. :thumbsup:
Sara: quick question — do we want to add latency SLOs to the ticket? customer asked for 200ms p95 for short prompts. realistic?
Kevin: 200ms p95 at 1-2 tokens? probably not for 14b on our general hosts; for dedicated with batching maybe. I'll include measured numbers in profile.
Mike: FYI — discovered a small tokenization quirk on the repo (leading space handling). patching and will include in PR.
Jordan: perfect. Jordan out.
